fields.medications:
• Paracetamol 500mg: 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for fever.
  • Drink plenty of fluids and rest.
    Additional Notes: Monitor temperature regularly. Seek medical attention if fever persists beyond 3 days.

• Amoxicillin 500mg: 1 capsule every 8 hours for 7 days.
  • Cetirizine 10mg: 1 tablet at night for 5 days.
  • Saltwater gargle twice daily.
    Additional Notes: Avoid cold beverages and dusty environments.

• Pantoprazole 40mg: 1 tablet before breakfast for 14 days.
  • Antacid syrup: 10ml after meals, 3 times daily.
    Additional Notes: Avoid spicy, fried foods. Eat smaller, more frequent meals.

• Methotrexate 7.5mg: 1 tablet once weekly.
  • Folic acid 5mg: 1 tablet the day after methotrexate.
    Additional Notes: Schedule a follow-up for evaluation and blood tests.

fields.symptoms: Chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations.
fields.medications:
• Amlodipine 5mg: 1 tablet daily in the morning.
  • Aspirin 75mg: 1 tablet daily after breakfast.
    Additional Notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly.

• Oral rehydration salts (ORS): Dissolve one sachet in 1 liter of water and sip frequently.
  • Loperamide 2mg: 1 tablet after each loose stool (maximum 4 tablets per day).
    Additional Notes: Avoid dairy products until recovery.

• Hydrocortisone cream: Apply thinly to the affected area twice daily.
  • Loratadine 10mg: 1 tablet daily for 7 days.
    Additional Notes: Identify and avoid allergens.
